# Labels, Layout & the Designer

**Controls on show:** `label`, plus a small mix (`slider`, `color`, `select`, `checkbox`).

**The one idea:** *there are two kinds of text, and they come from different places.*

- The **header band** — the bold title and grey description at the top of the UI cell — comes from the cell's top-level `title` and `description`. It renders *above* the control canvas, so it never overlaps a control.
- A **`label` control** lives *inside* the canvas at an `x/y`, like any other control. Use it as a section caption or a one-line note. It binds nothing — the Live-values cell below won't see it.

**Layout is absolute.** Every control needs `x`, `y`, `width`, `height` (in px). There's no flow/grid layout — you place things exactly. That sounds tedious, which is why the *designer* exists.

{

## The authoring surface (open the UI cell's editor to follow along)

Click the UI cell's **pencil** to enter *designer* mode. The canvas gains a grid and every control becomes draggable. Three tools make absolute layout bearable:

- **Tidy** (the ✨ wand button, bottom-left of the canvas) — *grid-packs* the controls left-to-right, top-to-bottom on the 20 px grid and *grows the surface to fit*. Drag things into a mess, hit Tidy, and it snaps back into clean rows. It never overlaps controls and never clips the surface.
- **Duplicate** (in the form editor) — copies the selected control, offset slightly, with the same type and settings. The fastest way to build a row of R/G/B sliders is: make one, Duplicate twice, rename the binds.
- **Keyboard nudging** — select a control and press the **arrow keys** to move it by one grid step (20 px); hold **Shift + arrows** to resize it. Pointer-free, pixel-honest alignment.

Everything you do in the designer just edits the same JSON you see in the `ui` cell — there's no hidden state. Switch back to the JSON view any time.

## Try this

- Enter the designer and drag the **Size** slider so it overlaps the **Colour** picker. Now press **Tidy** — watch them grid-pack into tidy rows and the surface resize to fit.
- Select the **Colour** control and tap **→** four times: it steps right 80 px (4 × 20). Hold **Shift** and press **↓** to make it taller. Read the JSON — the `x`/`height` numbers changed by multiples of 20.
- **Duplicate** the *Loop* checkbox, then change the copy's `bind` to `autoplay` and its `label` to *Autoplay*. Run the Live-values cell — a new boolean appears.
- Replace the header: clear the cell's `title`/`description` in the JSON. The band vanishes and the canvas moves up — proof the header is separate from the label controls, which stay put.
